text.tspan: ALB request flow: listener → rules → target groups
Targets (SG: app port from the ALB's SG only)
Health checks are set per target group.
The app sees the ALB's IP as the source; the real client
in all AZs, not per AZ
• ALB: on by default (can turn off
per target group), no inter-AZ fee
• CLB: off by default, free if on
• SNI: many certs on one listener,
